title: VoiceCallListItem - Data API
description: Represents a single phone number in a prioritized call list.

CallListId.description: The ID of the related call list.

Ordinal.description: The order of the item in the overall call list.

RelatedRecordId.description: The ID of the related record.

State.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
State.description: Whether the call list item is not called, called, or skipped.

special_access_rules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.
